\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw (0,0) -- (1,1);
  \node at (0,0) {A};
  \node at (1,1) {B};
  \draw[red] (2,2) circle (1);
  \foreach \p/\pos in {A/left, B/left, C/right, D/right}%
    \node[\pos] at (\p) {$\p$};
  \begin{scope}[shift={(3,0)}]
    \draw (0,0) rectangle (1,1);
  \end{scope}
  \node at (4,4)
    {\begin{itemize}
        \item prose in a node label still reflows to the width
      \end{itemize}
    };
\end{tikzpicture}

\begin{axis}
  \addplot {x^2};
  \addplot {x^3};
\end{axis}

Ordinary prose after the picture still fills greedily to the line width.
